# glinet_parental_control (Resource)

Manage the stock GL.iNet parental control global settings. Filter rules are left to the stock UI.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `auto_update` (Boolean) Update the rule set automatically.
- `delete_behavior` (String) Destroy behavior. `forget` releases Terraform ownership and preserves the UCI section; `delete` removes a Terraform-created named section. Firmware-owned anonymous sections are always preserved.
- `drop_anonymous` (Boolean) Drop traffic from unknown clients.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable parental control.
- `log_level` (Number) Log level.
- `source_devices` (Set of String) Interfaces the rules apply to, such as `br-lan`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable import identifier.
- `owner` (String) Owner token recorded with the router section. It detects another Terraform state that manages the same section.
- `uci_section` (String) Resolved UCI section name on the router.
